title: Two-Blade Bamboo Copter
description: One original static traditional hand-spun bamboo-copter gift toy: a continuous two-ended variable-chord wooden rotor with opposite local pitch and an integral thick central root, seated on one long tapered hand-rolling shaft. Two closed editable meshes and two opaque matte wood PBR roles. Not a recoloured paper pinwheel, spinning-top body or extracted aircraft propeller. Metres, Z up, front -Y and shaft-tip ground origin. Static display only: no flight, balance, durability, manufacture or child-safety claim.
